conclusions: Human confirmation establishes the visible symptom occurred during this recording.
No sampled texel showed the reported black flash. Sparse spatial coverage and pre-presentation sampling prevent an absence claim.
The player, Mongoose and observer state were captured before closing the run. Camera position exactly matches all attributed draw groups.
The first draw frame is partial. Albedo appears on both target meshes on every subsequent recorded frame; static-light passes occur on all recorded frames.
Sampler descriptors remain stable for the matched material passes; this does not prove stable GPU texture content.
No root cause is established; no shader, lighting or visibility fix is justified by this run alone.
next_steps: Validate an unattended native replay against the saved vehicle/camera transforms and original map identity.
Validate live vertex transformation and triangle coverage at sampled points before interpreting absent pulses.
Use targeted native numerical observation to locate the bad frame and its rendering pass; retain authored atmosphere and lights.
